behaviors.behavior: TransformTeSA first decomposes the input TeSA using BitRounding, passing the TeSA and a sampled bit option to BitRounding and receiving k rounded TeSAs.
behaviors.precondition: TransformTeSA(T) is invoked as part of execution-plan transformation; a bit option is sampled via SampleBitOption.

behaviors.behavior: BitRounding decomposes a TeSA based on both the quantization bit widths contained in the TeSA and the quantization bit widths supported by the hardware.
behaviors.precondition: The TeSA may contain multiple quantization bit widths; hardware has a set of natively supported bit widths.

evidence.quote: It first decomposes TeSA in BitRounding, based on both the quantization bit width that the TeSA contains and the possible quantization bit width supported by the hardware.

behaviors.behavior: When hardware supports both 4-bit and 8-bit, one rounding option is to round elements to 4-bit and 8-bit accordingly.
behaviors.precondition: Hardware natively supports 4-bit and 8-bit instructions; this bit option is selected.

behaviors.behavior: When hardware supports both 4-bit and 8-bit, another rounding option is to round all elements to 8-bit.
behaviors.precondition: Hardware natively supports 4-bit and 8-bit instructions; this bit option is selected.

behaviors.behavior: TransformTeSA returns a new transformation option per run, so repeated calls can yield different BitRounding outcomes.
behaviors.precondition: TransformTeSA is called repeatedly by the search loop.

evidence.quote: /* return a new transformation option per run */

behaviors.behavior: BitRounding 输出的每个 TeSA 只包含一种量化属性（即规则稀疏模式）。
behaviors.precondition: BitRounding 已对混合精度 TeSA 完成分解。

evidence.quote: a regular sparsity pattern means the TeSA of a tensor shows only one type of quantization attribute and one block size of pruning attribute.
a mixed precision TeSA can be decomposed to multiple TeSAs each of which has one precision.

behaviors.behavior: BitRounding 本身不在其产生的候选 TeSA 之间做选择；选择由搜索循环遍历各变换计划完成。
behaviors.precondition: TransformTeSA 产生多个变换计划。

evidence.quote: Given a TeSA, TransformTeSA may have multiple transformation plans. The process iterates over each plan to find the satisfied one (line 38).
